site.title: Zeron Design
site.description: Open Source UI components created by Zeron Design

tableDoc.rowIndex: Row index for proximity hover. Omit for header rows.

docMeta.homeDescription: Refined UI components with satisfying hover.

descriptions.surfaces: Five semantic surfaces with purpose-based shadows for light and dark mode.
descriptions.semantic-tokens: The complete runtime contract for color, surface, type, shape, and layering.
descriptions.scrollbars: A scrollbar that stays out of the way but never disappears, over shadcn's scroll-fade baseline — restyled to the shape system, native scroll on touch.
descriptions.motion: Spring tokens, faster exits, and reflow-free weight animation — the motion rules shared by every component.
descriptions.accordion: Collapsible sections with animated expand/collapse and proximity hover in grouped mode.
descriptions.badge: Compact label with solid and dot variants, Tailwind color palette, and three sizes.
descriptions.badge-overflow: Responsive badge list that collapses hidden items into an overflow count.
descriptions.breadcrumb: Composable path navigation with separators, current-page state, and collapsed levels.
descriptions.button: Buttons trigger actions and move people through a task. Choose a variant by priority and intent, not color alone.
descriptions.card: shadcn's compositional card, dressed in Zeron Design — stacked, inline, and grid layouts, borderless dividers, and 2-D proximity hover.
descriptions.checkbox: Compact checkbox with checked, mixed, disabled, validation, and form states.
descriptions.checkbox-group: Checkbox group with merged backgrounds for contiguous selections.
descriptions.color-picker: Color picker with HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH formats, alpha, swatches, and popover trigger.
descriptions.data-grid: Virtualized spreadsheet grid with inline editing, range selection, search, copy and paste, and pinned columns.
descriptions.data-table: TanStack data table with sorting, filters, pagination, selection, visibility, and pinning.
descriptions.dialog: Modal dialog with smooth enter/exit animations and overlay.
descriptions.dropdown: Menu-style dropdown with proximity hover and animated backgrounds.
descriptions.input: Text input with three variants, four sizes, and accessible validation states.
descriptions.input-copy: Read-only input with copy-to-clipboard button and animated feedback.
descriptions.input-group: Composable input with addons, compact actions, textarea support, and validation.
descriptions.kbd: Compact keycaps and shortcut groups for keyboard commands and interaction hints.
descriptions.popover: Collision-aware floating content with a liquid anchor-to-panel transition.
descriptions.radio-group: Composable radio controls with form support and enhanced proximity-hover rows.
descriptions.select: Animated select menu with bordered/borderless variants and optional icons.
descriptions.slider: Range slider with step snapping, range mode, and animated thumb.
descriptions.stepper: Accessible multi-step navigation with validation, completion states, and keyboard controls.
descriptions.switch: Toggle switch with animated thumb and label.
descriptions.table: Data table with row hover effects and semantic markup.
descriptions.tabs: Pill, segment, and underline tabs with a sliding active indicator.
descriptions.tooltip: Floating tooltip with spring-based animations and configurable placement.
descriptions.ask-user-questions: Stepped question flow with single/multi-select, optional 'other' input, and skip.
descriptions.chat-message: Chat transcript bubble with baked-in motion, user/assistant alignment, and file attachments.
descriptions.input-message: Chat-style message composer with auto-resizing textarea and configurable action slots.
descriptions.thinking-indicator: Animated status indicator with morphing SVG and cycling text.
descriptions.thinking-steps: Chain-of-thought display with sequential animation and collapsible steps.
